admission.justification: Realized across src/rh_pipeline/cli/extract.py, src/rh_pipeline/graph/stage_map.py and pyproject.toml with CLI tests proving deterministic output, temp-file cleanup and zero writes on typed errors, preventing partial or corrupted skeleton trees.

applicability: Command-line invocation of rh-extract across src/rh_pipeline/cli/extract.py, src/rh_pipeline/graph/stage_map.py and pyproject.toml.
conditions: Upstream Git root verification, symlink/path-escape checks, Lean parsing, stub rendering and DAG assembly complete entirely in memory before any file is staged or replaced.
StageMapError and UnsupportedLeanFormError print ERROR: to stderr and return exit code 2 with zero output files created; staging failures unlink all temporary files before propagating.
exclusions: Unexpected OS errors during staging or per-file os.replace propagate uncaught, argparse usage errors follow standard exit code 2 behavior, and unmapped files in out_skeleton_dir remain untouched.
statement: The rh-extract CLI entry point validates, parses, renders, and builds the DAG completely in memory before atomically writing skeleton files and dag/dag.json, exiting 2 with zero writes on StageMapError or UnsupportedLeanFormError and regenerating Stage 00 outputs byte-identically.
title: Fail-closed atomic rh-extract CLI and deterministic outputs
